NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT 
 
 
 This non-disclosure agreement ( “ Agreement ” ) is made on [ ● ] July , 20 20 . 
 BY &amp; BETWEEN : 
 [ ● ] , a corporation of the [ ● ] , having its principal place of business located at [ ● ] for itself and on behalf of its affiliates   ( Recipient ) ; 
 A nd 
 EMERGING MARKETS PROPERTY GROUP , incorporated as EMPG Holdings Ltd, a company registered in Dubai International Financial Centre with its registered office at Unit 26, Level 3, Building GV10, DIFC, Dubai, UAE ( the “ Company ” ) . 
 Each of (1) and (2) a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”. 
 RECITALS : 
 WHEREAS i n connection with the Proposed Transaction ( as defined below ) , the Recipient recognis e s that it may be necessary or desirable for the Company to disclose to the Recipient certain Confidential Information ( as defined below ) and the Company wishes to ensure that such Confidential Information disclosed to Recipient in the course of the negotiations regarding the Proposed Transaction , remains confidential and is not used by Recipient for any purpose other than the Permitted Purpose ( as defined below ); and 
 WHEREAS t his Agreement sets out the terms upon which the Company agree s to provide Recipient with such Confidential I nformation. 
 THE PARTIES agree as follows: 
 Interpretation 
 In this Agreement : 
 Authorised Recipient ( s ) means each member o f the Recipient Group and their and Recipient’s respective directors, employees , officers, agents, representatives, consultants, professional advisers, bankers, potential investors and lenders of debt finance, as the case may be, and any third party who reasonably require access to the Confidential Information for the Permitted Purpose and for whom the Recipient has received consent to disclose Confidential Inform ation pursuant to Clause REF _Ref254019592 \w \h 3.1(b) below ; pro vided that no such Authorised Recipient is, directly or indirectly, associated with the Lazada Group including its subsidiar y( ies ) which will inter alia include its subsidiary in Pakistan namely Daraz Pakistan (Private) Limited. 
 Confidential Information means any information relating to the Proposed Transaction supplied by the Company to Recipient , either in writing or orally, and shall not include any Excluded Information . Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, Confidential Information shall include inter alia proprietary , business, technical , financial or legal information of the Company, including but not limited to: (a) information in tangible or intangible form relating to Google Analytics, client database, released or unreleased products or services or the marketing or promotion thereof (including pricing), business policies or practices, financial condition, operations, facilities, equipment, software, procurement and/or purchasing requirements, customers (former, current, or potential), investors, employees, business and contractual relationships, business forecasts, sales and merchandising data, or marketing methods and plans; (b) patents and patent applications; (c) techniques, sketches, drawings, works of authorship, models, inventions, processes, equipment, algorithms, and formulae related to current, future and/or proposed products and services, including information concerning research, development, design details and specifications; and (d) information received from third parties that the Recipient is obligated to treat as confidential ; 
 Excluded Informati o n means any information that (a) is now or becomes generally known to the public; (b) is independently developed by Recipient or Authorised Recipients without use or reference to any Confidential Information ; (c) Recipient or Authorised Recipient lawfully obtain s from any third party , provided that the Rec ipient or Authorised Recipient had no reason to believe that such third party was under any obligation of confidentiality in relation thereto ; (d) is published or generally disclosed to the public by the Company ; (e) is already known or available to the Recipient or Authorised Recipient ; (f) is required to be disclosed pursuant to any applicable statute, law, rule or regulation of any governmental authority or pursuant to any order of any court of competent jurisdiction ; or ( g ) has been approved in writing for release by the Company ; 
 Permitted Purpose means : 
 considering and evaluating whether to enter into the Proposed Transaction; 
 entering into the Proposed Transaction; and 
 performing obligations in accordance with the terms of any and all definitive agreements entered into in connectio n with the Proposed Transaction; 
 Proposed Transaction means the evaluation of a potential business opportunity , or provision of certain services by the Recipient to the Compan y under a formal agreement ; and 
 Recipient Group means any company or any body corporate which is, from time to time, a holding company of Recipient, a subsidiary of Recipient or a subsidiary of a holding company of Recipient (which expressions shall have the meanings attributed to them in the relevant statutes(s) in accordance with the governing law of this Agreement ) . 
 Secondary Information means reports, interpretations, forecasts, analyses, compilations , memoranda or other documents prepared by Recipient or by any of the Authorised Recipients on Recipient’s or any member of the Recipient Group’s behalf which contain or otherwise reflect in whole or in part any of the Confidential Information . 
 In this Agreement, a reference to: 
 a person includes a reference to that person ' s legal personal representatives, successors and permitted assigns; and 
 the singular includes the plural and vice versa (unless the conte x t otherwise requires). 
 Confidentiality OBLIGATIONs 
 2.1 In consideration for the Company making available to Recipient the Confidential Information, and subject to Clause REF _Ref254019485 \w \h 3 , Recipient undertakes : 
 to keep the Confidential Information and Secondary Information confidential and not to disclose it to any person; and 
 not to make use of the Confidential Information and Secondary Information for any purpose other than for the Permitted Purpose. 
 The Company also undertake s to keep confidential and not disclose to any person the existence of, and any facts pertaining to, the Proposed Transaction (including the existence and contents of this Agreement), without the prior written consent of the Company . 
 The Recipient shall not develop or have developed products, services, methods of conducting business, concepts, systems or techniques that are similar to or compete with the products, services, methods of conducting business, concepts, systems or techniques contemplated by or embodied in the Company’s Confidential Information. 
 The Recipient acknowledge s that it will not, and will cause its Authorised Recipients not to, disclose or share Confidential Information with any of its directors, employees and/or officers who have any responsibility or involvement directly or indirectly, in the U.A.E or Pakistan with any business or entity that competes , directly or indirectly, with the Company including inter alia with the Lazada Group including its subsidiary( ies ) which will inter alia include its subsidiary in Pakistan namely Daraz Pakistan (Private) Limited. 
 2. 5 The Recipient shall take all reasonable measur e s to ensure that all Authorised Recipients are at the least subject to the requirements of confidentiality as contained in this Agreement and shall, if required by the Company, direct them to execute and deliver in the form of this Agreement an acknowledgement of the confidentiality of the Confidential Information. 
 Permitted Disclosure 
 The Company agrees that the Recipient may disclose the Confidential Information and Secondary Information : 
 to the Authori sed Recipients; 
 to any person with the Company's prior written consent ; 
 where the Recipient is required to disclose the Confidential Information by any court of competent jurisdiction or any competent judicial, governmental, supervisory or regulatory body provided that the Rec ipient shall cooperate with the Company to minimize the extent of any such disclosure, including but not limited to giving the Company advance written notice of the anticipated disclosure ; or 
 where the Recipient is required to disclose the Confidential Information under any law or regulation with which the Recipient is required to comply , 
 always provided that the Recipient shall be responsible for any breach by an Authorised Recipient of the terms of this Agreement , and that the Recipient shall notify the Company immediately upon discovery of any unauthoris ed use or disclosure of Confidential Information or any other breach of this Agreement by the Recipient or Authorised Recipient s , and the Rec ipient shall cooperate with the Company in every reasonable way to help the Company regain possession of the Confidential Information an d prevent its further unauthoris ed use or disclosure . 
 Prior to any disclosure under Clause REF _Ref254019497 \w \h 3.1 , Recipient shall inform the Authori s ed Recipients , and any person referred to in Clause REF _Ref254019592 \w \h 3.1(b) , (c) and (d) of the confidential nature of the Confidential Information and obligations of confidentiality in relation thereto . 
 Return or destruction of Confidential Information 
 If the Company so requests in writing, Recipient shall either return or destroy all Confidential Information supplied by the Company to it (other than any Secondary Information), save to the extent that it or any of its Authorised Recipients is required to retain any Confidential Information by any (a) law; (b) rule or regulation; or (c) competent judicial, governmental, supervisory or regulatory body. This obligation to destroy or erase any Confidential Information will not prevent Recipient or any of the Authorised Recipients or any person referred to in Clause REF _Ref254019592 \w \h \* MERGEFORMAT 3.1(b) (as the case may be) from ( i ) retaining one copy-set of documents for its own internal audit purposes and (ii) retaining computer records or files containing Confidential Information which have been created or stored pursuant to an automatic, routine, electronic archiving and back-up procedure . 
 For the avoidance of doubt, any Confidential Information retained under this provision shall be retained subject to the terms of this Agreement. 
 Term of Agreement 
 T he obligations in this Agreement shall cease thirty- six (36) months from the date of this Agreement , unless agreed otherwise in writing between the Parties . 
 Ownership of Confidential Information 
 T he Parties agree s that no right or licence is granted to Recipient in relation to the Confidential Information. 
 General 
 No Representations and Warranties : The Confidential Information is being provided to the Recipient “as is” and without any representation or warranty of any kind, either express or implied. The Recipient understands and agrees that neither the Company nor any of its Representatives makes any representation or warranty, express or implied, as to the accuracy or completeness of the Confidential Information, nor will it have any liability to the Recipient , its Authorized Recipients, or any other p erson , in relation to or resulting from the use of the Confidential Information, or any errors there in or omissions therefrom. 
 No Relation: This Agreement does not create any association, partnership, employment or joint venture between the Parties. Neither Party shall have the right, nor power nor authority at any time to act for or on behalf of or represent the other Party. 
 No Liability : The Recipient understands and agrees that any Confidential Information prepared by the Company was prepared for their internal purposes only, and thus may not be suitable for the Recipient’s purpose. The Recipient acknowledges and agrees that the Recipient will make its own independent evaluation of the Proposed Transaction and will not be relying on the Company in connection with the Proposed Transaction , and that the Company is not acting as the Recipients’ broker or advisor in connection with the Proposed Transaction. 
 Indemnity : The Recipient agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Company from and against all sums of money, actions, proceedings, suits, claims, demands, costs, expenses and any other amounts whatsoever incurred as a result of the unauthorised and unlawful disclosure of Confidential Information to any third party by a wrongful act, error, omission or negligence of the Recipient and/or Authorised Recipients . This clause shall survive termination of this Agreement. 
 No Waiver: A Party ' s failure or delay in exercising any right, power or privilege under this Agreement will not operate as a waiver thereof nor will any single or partial exercise of any right, power or privilege by that Party preclude any further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right, power or privilege hereunder. 
 Amendments: The terms of this Agreement and a Party ' s obligation hereunder may only be amended or modified by written agreement between the Parties. 
 Validity; Enforceability : If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable, that provision shall (so far as it is invalid or unenforceable) be given no effect and shall be deemed not to be included in this Agreement, but shall not invalidat e any other provision in this Agreement . 
 Entire Agreement : This Agreement constitutes the whole agreement between the Parties as of the date of this Agreement and there are no terms or conditions of such Agreement other than those contained in this Agreement. No variation of this Agreement shall be valid unless it is in writing and signed on behalf of each of the Parties. 
 Authorised Contact; Communication : Any communication or notice required or permitted under this Agreement by either Party shall be in writing and shall be deemed to have been given on the date received and may be delivered personally, by reput able overnight delivery service or by fax or electronic mail to the following addresses:

 No Obligation : Nothing in this A greement shall create an obligation upon the Company to provide the Recipient with acce ss to any information or to enter into the Proposed Transaction. 
 Counterparts : This Agreement may be entered into in any number of counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute on e and the same agreement. Any P arty may enter into this Agreement by signing any such counterpart. 
 No Assignment 
 This Agreement or any interest therein shall not be assigned in whole or in part without the prior written consent of the other Party. 
 Governing Law and DISPUTE RESOLUTION 
 This Agreement and any disputes or claims arising out of, or in connection with, its subject matter are to be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales , without regard to the laws of conflict of laws . 
 A ny dispute, controversy or claim arising out of, or relating to, this Agreement including any dispute regarding its existence, its validi ty or termination (“ Dispute ”) shall be submitted to senior representatives appointed by the Parties, who will meet to discuss a resolution to the Dispute. If the appointed senior representatives are unable to resolve the Dispute within ten ( 10 ) days of either Party notifying the Dispute to the other Party, the Dispute shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the DIFC-LCIA Rules, which Rules are deemed to be incorporated by reference into this clause. 
   
 The  number of arbitrators shall be one . The seat of the arbitration shall be Dubai, UAE . The language to be used in the arbitral proceedings shall be English. 
 
 AS WITNESS this Agreement has been signed by the parties (or their duly authorised representatives) on the date stated at the beginning of this Agreement.
